description: Oscilloscope with four lanes stacked down the screen and eight inputs, drawn two to a lane, each trace in the colour of the cable patched to it

params.text: Sets how much time one screen covers, 5ms at the top of its travel to 50 seconds at the bottom; it is invisible and is set by dragging up and down anywhere over the display
Switches the sweep between waiting for a trigger and running free: lit, each sweep starts at a rising crossing of 0V on the first patched input; dark, sweeps follow one another at once

inputs.text: One of the four signals given a lane of its own, ±10V filling the height of the lane
Drawn over the lane belonging to the jack directly above it, ±10V filling the height of the lane

notes: the trigger lamp comes up dark, so the picture free-runs until you click it.
the trace for a jack is drawn in the colour of the cable patched into it, which is the only thing telling two traces in one lane apart.
